description: Under review: Voidly's national blocklist layer let false positives through in open countries and is being rebuilt with a stricter rule, so this tool lists no domain as blocked. It answers verdict unknown with a review object (reason, data date = the layer's window end, see link), the layer window (confirmed_block_layer) and per-country measured-domain coverage. A domain's absence from any list is not evidence of access. For citable censorship events use get_active_incidents.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. IR, RU, TR

name: get_national_blocklist
